public_positioning: Kingsmen is a private route house / private route command house, not a cheap application-help service.
rules: Free Destiny Map is R0 with 0 managed applications and all-sector preview only.
Exact targets, application links, and manual route plans remain sealed until package activation.
CV Revamp is R49.99 and includes truthful personalised CV and motivation outputs.
Accommodation Support Package is R179.00 for 8 accommodation routes standalone.
Paid Kingsmen packages include up to 8 ACC-01 accommodation routes.
All sectors remain open to every user.
Packages control intensity, monitoring, priority, and route count.
